async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Navigate to the project settings page
    settings_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Settings')
    await settings_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Locate and click the 'Members' link in settings
    members_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Members')
    await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Add each member
    members_to_add = ['primer', 'convexegg', 'abishek']
    for member in members_to_add:
        # Click the 'Add member' button
        add_member_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Add member')
        await add_member_button.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Fill in the member's username or email
        member_input = page.get_by_label('GitLab member or Email address')
        await member_input.fill(member)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Select an access level (assuming default, e.g., 'Maintainer')
        access_level_dropdown = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Access level')
        await access_level_dropdown.select_option('Maintainer')
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Click the 'Add to project' button
        add_to_project_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Add to project')
        await add_to_project_button.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the member to be added
    # After adding all members, wait for any final loading
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)

async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Navigate to the project settings page
    settings_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Settings')
    await settings_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Locate and click the 'Members' link in settings
    members_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Members')
    await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Add each member
    members_to_add = ['primer', 'convexegg', 'abishek']
    for member in members_to_add:
        # Click the 'Add member' button
        add_member_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Add member')
        await add_member_button.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Fill in the member's username or email
        member_input = page.get_by_label('GitLab member or Email address')
        await member_input.fill(member)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Select an access level (assuming default, e.g., 'Maintainer')
        access_level_dropdown = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Access level')
        await access_level_dropdown.select_option('Maintainer')
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Click the 'Add to project' button
        add_to_project_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Add to project')
        await add_to_project_button.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the member to be added
    # After adding all members, wait for any final loading
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)

async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Navigate to the project settings page
    settings_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Settings')
    await settings_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Locate and click the 'Members' link in settings
    members_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Members')
    await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Add each member
    members_to_add = ['primer', 'convexegg', 'abishek']
    for member in members_to_add:
        # Click the 'Add member' button
        add_member_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Add member')
        await add_member_button.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Fill in the member's username or email
        member_input = page.get_by_label('GitLab member or Email address')
        await member_input.fill(member)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Select an access level (assuming default, e.g., 'Maintainer')
        access_level_dropdown = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Access level')
        await access_level_dropdown.select_option('Maintainer')
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Click the 'Add to project' button
        add_to_project_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Add to project')
        await add_to_project_button.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the member to be added
    # After adding all members, wait for any final loading
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
